approvalNote: UNAPPROVED. Traced and rendered, not yet read against ref.png by a human.

regions.note: One sentence naming the method as a whole. Optional — without it the step row rises.

children.note: What the step achieves, not what it is called.

invariants: Second-level items carry .sub-item and sit at 16px. That is legal ONLY because .sub-item is on the §15.10 closed list; the same copy in a .body would FAIL, and should.
No chevrons. The source's arrow-tipped headers are ornament the dot system does not sanction, and the sequence is already carried by the ordinal and the reading order.
Panels are equal height and the row is CENTRED in the band below the lede. Stretching them to the foot makes five hollow panels; letting them sit at the top kills the lower third.
Five steps is the ceiling. At six the panel width falls below what 16px second-level copy can hold without every line wrapping.
Panels clip. A step whose activities overflow gets fewer activities, not smaller type (§4.5).

grounds.note: The panels are the dark moment, not the slide. .slide--navy would invert the whole canvas.
